svg.title: Sorted and unsorted
svg.desc: Two renders of the mannequin at the same instant of its walk. Left: imported correctly, a standing figure mid-stride. Right: the same joints built in the order of the file's node array, where every parent comes after its child; each joint is composed as a root at its own offset from the origin, and the body is a pile of parts at the feet.
svg.text: joints in node-array order: 19 of 20 out of order
